Metadata.title: ApplyTrack - Track Your Job Applications
Metadata.description: Manage and track every job application in one place. Start free with no account, sync automatically once you sign up.

Hero.headline: One tidy place for your job applications.
Hero.subtext: Track the company, role, and status of every application. Start with no account, or save it to stay safe everywhere.

Features.heading: Everything you need for an organized job search.
Features.listBody: Company, role, applied date, salary expectations, and interview notes, all kept tidy and easy to search.
Features.statusBody: See progress from wishlist to job offer at a glance.
Features.syncBody: Guest-mode data moves to your account the moment you sign up, nothing gets left behind.
Features.securityBody: Once you're signed in, your application data is protected by row-level security in Supabase, only you can access it.

HowItWorks.heading: Three steps, no hassle.
HowItWorks.step1Body: Add the company and role as soon as you apply, it takes under a minute.
HowItWorks.step2Body: Move it along when you get an interview invite, an offer, or any other news.
HowItWorks.step3Body: See a summary of every active application and which ones need a follow-up.

GuestVsAccount.heading: Try it as a guest, keep going with an account.
GuestVsAccount.guestPoint1: Start right away, no sign-up form to fill in
GuestVsAccount.guestPoint2: Data stays on this device (local storage)
GuestVsAccount.guestPoint3: Good for trying it out before you commit
GuestVsAccount.accountPoint1: Data is stored safely on the server, it survives a cleared cache
GuestVsAccount.accountPoint2: Accessible from your laptop, phone, or any other device
GuestVsAccount.accountPoint3: Guest-mode applications move over automatically when you sign up

FinalCta.heading: Get your job search organized today.
FinalCta.subtext: No credit card, no sign-up required.
